title: Function coverage for Write Multiple Registers
purpose: Provide a valid multi-register write with matched quantity and byte-count fields.
expected_behavior: Server should parse the request as Write Multiple Registers starting at 0x0001, quantity 0x0002, byte count 0x04, with two register values 0x000A and 0x000B.
constraints_preserved: length is 0x000b for unit_id plus 10-byte function 0x10 PDU.
Function code 0x10 is used for Write Multiple Registers.
Quantity 0x0002 matches byte count 0x04 and exactly two 16-bit register values.
issue_safety_notes: This seed stays fully coherent and avoids inflated counts or malformed payload lengths.
